title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
description: Retail sale price of the package shall be clearly indicated as 'Maximum or Max. Retail Price inclusive of all taxes' or 'MRP Rs./₹ ... incl. of all taxes'.
gazetteReference: Notified vide G.S.R. 629(E) dated 23-06-2017 & G.S.R. 779(E) dated 02-11-2021
whatCanBeDetected: Presence of declared price, currency identifier (₹ or Rs.), and tax-inclusive designation.
legalLimitations: Screening verifies label printing; overcharging above MRP at point-of-sale is an in-person enforcement check.

title: Net Quantity Declaration
description: Net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight or measure (g, kg, ml, l) or number (N / units) shall be clearly declared.
gazetteReference: Principal Notification G.S.R. 202(E) dated 07-03-2011 read with Second Schedule
whatCanBeDetected: Declared quantity with standard metric units or piece count.
legalLimitations: Screening verifies declaration presence and standard units; physical weight/volume verification requires calibrated scales.

title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name
description: Name of the manufacturer, or where manufacturer is not the packer, name of manufacturer and packer; or for imported packages, name of importer.
whatCanBeDetected: Presence of manufacturer, packer, or importer business entity declaration and statutory prefix.
legalLimitations: Screening checks for declared entity name; legal corporate status requires registrar verification.

title: Premises / Factory / Registered Address
description: Complete postal address of premises or factory of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be clearly indicated.
whatCanBeDetected: Presence of postal address cues, locality, state, or 6-digit postal PIN code.
legalLimitations: OCR cannot verify full legal adequacy of postal address; physical inspection is recommended if address appears truncated.

title: Month & Year of Manufacture / Packing
description: Month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported must be clearly indicated.
whatCanBeDetected: Month & Year format (MM/YYYY, MM/YY, or Month Year) with contextual prefix (MFD/PKD).
legalLimitations: Screening flags missing dates, ambiguous dates lacking statutory prefix, and post-dated / future manufacturing dates.

title: Consumer Care Redressal Details
description: Name, address, telephone number, and email address of consumer contact cell must be declared for grievance redressal.
gazetteReference: Inserted vide G.S.R. 359(E) dated 06-06-2013 and amended by G.S.R. 629(E)
whatCanBeDetected: Presence of telephone helpline, toll-free contact number, or consumer complaint email.
legalLimitations: Screening verifies contact declaration presence; operational status of consumer helpline requires physical testing.
